title: Isha prayer
intro: The night prayer: 4 sunnah, 4 fard, 2 sunnah and 3 rak‘ahs of Witr – 13 rak‘ahs.

learn.html: Isha is the night prayer – the fifth prayer of the day. Its time begins when night has fully fallen. It has 13 rak‘ahs: four sunnah, four fard, two sunnah and three rak‘ahs of Witr. We pray the first sunnah, then the fard, then the last sunnah, and at the very end Witr.

learn.label: Niyyah for the sunnah of Isha
learn.ar: نَوَيْتُ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى صَلَاةَ سُنَّةِ الْعِشَاءِ أَدَاءً مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبْلَةِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
learn.tr: Nawaytu an usalliya lillaahi ta‘aalaa salaata sunnatil-‘ishaa’i, adaa’an mustaqbilal-qiblati. Allaahu akbar!
learn.en: I intend to pray, for Allah, the sunnah of Isha, on time, facing the Qiblah. Allah is the Greatest!

items: 1st rak‘ah: Subhanaka, A‘udhu, Bismillah, Al-Fatiha and a surah
2nd rak‘ah: Bismillah, Al-Fatiha and a surah
First sitting: At-Tahiyyat and the salawat
3rd rak‘ah: Subhanaka, Bismillah, Al-Fatiha and a surah
4th rak‘ah: Bismillah, Al-Fatiha and a surah
Last sitting: At-Tahiyyat, salawat, duas and salam

learn.label: Niyyah for the fard of Isha
learn.ar: نَوَيْتُ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى صَلَاةَ فَرْضِ الْعِشَاءِ أَدَاءً مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبْلَةِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
learn.tr: Nawaytu an usalliya lillaahi ta‘aalaa salaata fardil-‘ishaa’i, adaa’an mustaqbilal-qiblati. Allaahu akbar!
learn.en: I intend to pray, for Allah, the fard of Isha, on time, facing the Qiblah. Allah is the Greatest!

items: 1st rak‘ah: Subhanaka, A‘udhu, Bismillah, Al-Fatiha and a surah
2nd rak‘ah: Bismillah, Al-Fatiha and a surah
First sitting: At-Tahiyyat
3rd rak‘ah: Bismillah and Al-Fatiha
4th rak‘ah: Bismillah and Al-Fatiha
Last sitting: At-Tahiyyat, salawat, duas and salam

learn.label: Niyyah for the last sunnah of Isha
learn.ar: نَوَيْتُ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى صَلَاةَ سُنَّةِ الْعِشَاءِ أَدَاءً مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبْلَةِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
learn.tr: Nawaytu an usalliya lillaahi ta‘aalaa salaata sunnatil-‘ishaa’i, adaa’an mustaqbilal-qiblati. Allaahu akbar!
learn.en: I intend to pray, for Allah, the (last) sunnah of Isha, on time, facing the Qiblah. Allah is the Greatest!

items: 1st rak‘ah: Subhanaka, A‘udhu, Bismillah, Al-Fatiha and a surah
2nd rak‘ah: Bismillah, Al-Fatiha and a surah
Last sitting: At-Tahiyyat, salawat, duas and salam

learn.label: Niyyah for Witr
learn.ar: نَوَيْتُ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى صَلَاةَ الْوِتْرِ أَدَاءً مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبْلَةِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
learn.tr: Nawaytu an usalliya lillaahi ta‘aalaa salaatal-witri, adaa’an mustaqbilal-qiblati. Allaahu akbar!
learn.en: I intend to pray, for Allah, the Witr prayer, on time, facing the Qiblah. Allah is the Greatest!

items: 1st rak‘ah: Subhanaka, A‘udhu, Bismillah, Al-Fatiha and a surah
2nd rak‘ah: Bismillah, Al-Fatiha and a surah
First sitting: At-Tahiyyat
3rd rak‘ah: Bismillah, Al-Fatiha and a surah – then we say the takbir (Allaahu akbar) and recite the Qunut du‘a
Last sitting: At-Tahiyyat, salawat, duas and salam

practice.title: Questions and tasks
prompts: 💬 How many rak‘ahs does Isha have, and how are they divided? What is the niyyah for the fard of Isha, and for Witr?

📋 In your maktab notebook, draw a table of what we recite in each rak‘ah of Isha. Colour the rak‘ahs where we recite the same thing with the same colour, and compare it with the other four daily prayers.
💬 Talk with your muallim: I am happy that I end my day with Salah and begin it with Salah!
